append_metrics.name: Lumentum EML laser capacity investment (NVIDIA partnership)
append_metrics.description: NVIDIA invested $2.0 billion in Lumentum (March 2026) for EML laser capacity expansion and priority access. Part of $4B optical supply lockup strategy.

node_patches.append_notes: As primary EML/DFB supplier (~28% market share), Lumentum is critical to AI transceiver scaling. NVIDIA's $2B investment (March 2026) secures priority capacity and R&D for next-gen laser components. Vertically integrated epitaxy and device fabrication in-house; has locked multi-year InP substrate contracts to mitigate upstream supply risk.

append_metrics.name: Coherent InP epitaxy capacity (in-house)
append_metrics.description: Coherent operates in-house InP epitaxial growth capability across two fabs (6-inch wafers), estimated 1,500–2,000 wafers/month throughput for laser and photodiode production.

append_metrics.name: Coherent NVIDIA partnership investment
append_metrics.description: NVIDIA invested $2.0 billion in Coherent (March 2026) for integrated photonics capacity expansion and priority supply. Part of $4B optical supply lockup strategy.

node_patches.append_notes: Coherent (formerly II-VI) is second-largest EML/DFB supplier (~25% share) with full vertical integration: substrate contracts + in-house epitaxy + device fabrication. Performs ~20 years of in-house InP capability, mitigating upstream supply risk. NVIDIA's $2B investment (March 2026) accelerates capacity ramp. Currently supply-constrained but expanding aggressively.

append_metrics.name: Mitsubishi Electric EML laser market share
append_metrics.description: Mitsubishi Electric estimated ~20–25% of global EML/DFB datacom laser market share; third-largest supplier after Lumentum and Coherent. In-house epitaxy and device fabrication.

node_patches.append_notes: Mitsubishi Electric is established EML/DFB laser supplier with in-house capability (epitaxy + fabrication). Approximately 20–25% global market share; supplies to regional and global transceiver makers. Capacity less publicized than Lumentum/Coherent but meaningful contributor to global EML supply diversification.

append_metrics.name: Broadcom optical transceiver module market share
append_metrics.description: Broadcom dominates optical transceiver module market (400G+) with ~45% share; primary ASIC and VCSEL supplier integrated into module design.

append_metrics.name: Broadcom EML laser market entry status
append_metrics.description: Broadcom late entrant to EML laser supply (~2024); historically dominant in VCSEL but less vertically integrated in EML epitaxy. Capacity ramp ongoing but lags Lumentum and Coherent.

node_patches.append_notes: Broadcom is the largest optical transceiver module supplier (45% share) with in-house VCSEL design/manufacturing. Late entry into EML laser supply (2024) relative to Lumentum/Coherent; currently capacity-constrained in EML relative to market demand. Efforts to expand EML through partnerships and internal development underway.
